verdicts.reason: A puts the CTA first on the far left, which inverts the reading order. It also shrinks the 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon into an unreadable sticker crammed against the subcopy, and the legal text is set as large as the subcopy with almost no gap above the tiny logo. B keeps the brand → ribbon → bottle → headline → CTA order and keeps the ribbon readable, but the headline is squeezed into three tall lines, and the legal text is a cramped six-line column jammed against the right edge at the same size as the subcopy.
